review_description: The Principal of the firm visited the site and provided sound advise in a timely manner. The formal quotation and subsequent changes and additions were communicated quickly.  Following electrical supply company approval, the installation was completed as scheduled.  The finish is all neat and tidy and thoroughly professional.  The paper work for the grid connection was completed by the installer and the meter change over is scheduled.
Local family run business that was very professional and installed a good quality system at a competitive price.

All the companies gave quotes without seeing the property. In the small print there were hidden costs. One company was going to charge me $500 to come out and quote. Forster Solar and Lighting visited the property and gave me a firm quote with no hidden costs. The job was done in one day, connected and pouring power into the grid the same day.
